description: Get a URL where people take a quiz in their browser with no sign-in, and set who can open it. `unlisted` (the default) works for anyone with the link and is never listed or indexed; `public` also lists it in the quiz library and search engines; `private` turns the link off. Returns visibility, playUrl, quizUrl (public quizzes only) and embedHtml. Fails if the quiz has no questions with answers yet.
name: quiz_video_share_quiz
title: Share a quiz as a playable link
